facts.fact: The article says the ENTICS sample was drawn from the base of the fifth Population and Housing Census (RGPH-5) of 2023.
ARTP's ENTICS survey reports 59.7% of women and 50.8% of men used the internet in the last thirty days, a gap of -17.5 per cent of men's rate (women higher).

SEN.note: Gives internet use by sex and 19.4% of households with home internet, but no share of the whole population using the internet.
